captions.detailed: A mountain bike crankset assembly consisting of a central dark grey bottom bracket shell, a metallic silver spindle, and two silver crank arms. One crank arm features an integrated spider holding a black, multi-toothed narrow-wide chainring. Rectangular black pedals are attached to the ends of each crank arm. The entire crank assembly (crank arms and chainring) rotates continuously around the spindle axis, while each pedal rotates independently on its respective axle.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a mountain bike crankset with a boost-spaced bottom-bracket shell, two metallic silver crank arms, a single black chainring, and two black pedals. The design must support continuous rotational articulation of the crank assembly about the spindle axis, and independent rotational articulation for each pedal on its spindle.
captions.factory: The code constructs the assembly by first defining a stationary bottom-bracket shell using a cylinder. It then creates the rotating crank assembly, combining a spindle (cylinder), two crank arms (extruded profiles), a multi-toothed chainring (polar array of teeth subtracted/added to a disk), and connecting hardware. Finally, it models two rectangular pedals using boxes with filleted edges. Continuous joints are established using the `articulation` builder: one joint connects the crank assembly to the bottom bracket shell, and two additional joints connect the left and right pedals to their respective crank arm ends.
